description: Agent for maternal-fetal surveillance, antenatal risk stratification, intrapartum CTG monitoring, and obstetric complications management.

inputs.name: gestational_profile
inputs.description: LMP, dating ultrasound biometry, gestational age, parity, gravidity

inputs.name: fetal_biometry
inputs.description: BPD, HC, AC, FL in mm, AFI in cm, and Doppler pulsatility indices

inputs.name: ctg_features
inputs.description: Baseline FHR, variability, accelerations, decelerations, and contraction rate

inputs.name: maternal_vitals_biomarkers
inputs.description: Blood pressure, MAP, sFlt-1/PlGF ratio, proteinuria, platelets, AST, ALT

inputs.name: cervical_assessment
inputs.description: Dilation, effacement, station, consistency, position for Bishop score

inputs.name: pph_risk_factors
inputs.description: Uterine overdistension, prior PPH, prolonged labor, coagulation status

outputs.name: fetal_growth_analysis
outputs.description: Hadlock EFW (grams), percentile, and FGR/LGA classification

outputs.name: ctg_interpretation
outputs.description: NICHD Category I/II/III classification, clinical severity, and urgent interventions

outputs.name: preeclampsia_evaluation
outputs.description: Hypertensive disorder tier, angiogenic status, and severe features

outputs.name: labor_induction_readiness
outputs.description: Modified Bishop score, cervical ripeness, and ripening recommendations

outputs.name: pph_risk_stratification
outputs.description: 4T assessment, cumulative risk tier, and prevention protocol recommendations
